title: herdr executor tests leak their fake agents: 5 orphaned fake-agent.sh per test run, alive for days
description: Reported 2026-10-11 from the thorpeleverage session: 80 orphaned /bin/sh internal/exec/herdr/testdata/fake-agent.sh processes, PPID 1, 3-7 days old, 16 each from TestAWorkingAgentIsNotNudged, TestAReportThatStaysUnreadableIsMissingResultAfterThePanePushbac(k), TestAnUnverifiedKindKeepsTheGraceForAnAgentStillWorking, TestAnUnreadableReportIsPushedBackInThePaneAndAcceptedWhenFixed, TestAnAgentThatNeverReportsIsMissingResultAfterTheNudgesAreSpent — 5 per run of the package, run from epic-t8u worker worktrees (0bg, o3q, p4c, pqs, r1f, u51, x73). These are the modes that never exit on their own (sleep/ignore/esc_only); the fake agent is started detached (harness_test.go ~447) and t.Cleanup never kills it. A leak of this exact class was cleaned by hand before (fake-agent.sh, 2026-10). Killed by exact pid 2026-10-11. Fix: start the fake agent in its own process group and kill the group in t.Cleanup; make fake-agent.sh exit when its temp dir or parent disappears; add a package TestMain leak check that fails if any fake agent this package started is still alive.
acceptance_criteria: running go test ./internal/exec/herdr/ leaves no fake-agent.sh process behind (leak check in TestMain fails without the fix); make gate
